bias.en: Downtrend · broke $211.6, MACD and SAR turned down
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $211.6，MACD 与 SAR 同步转空

read.en: Teradyne fell 10.0% on Nov 20 to $204.78, its lowest close since Dec 31, 2025, trading $201.87–222.62 on above-average volume (1.33x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($226.7), 10-day ($240.4), 30-day ($285.3), 100-day ($346.9) and 200-day ($349.3), all falling. MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 20, below zero; Parabolic SAR turned bearish the same day ($273.22), and RSI is 29.2, oversold.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 11月20日下跌 10.0%，收于 $204.78，为 2025年12月31日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $201.87–222.62，成交量高于均值（为 20 日均量的 1.33 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$226.7）、10 日（$240.4）、30 日（$285.3）、100 日（$346.9）和 200 日均线（$349.3）下方，均在下行。MACD 于 11月20日下穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 同日转为看空（$273.22），RSI 为 29.2，处于超卖区。

read.en: The drop broke both written supports, $222.5–222.9 (Nov 9 and 17 lows) and $211.6–212.7 (Nov 5 low and close), now resistance. Resistance is $205–212.7, then $220.3–222.9 (Jan 20 low, Nov 20 high) and $226.7–228.9 (5-day). Support is $201.9–202 (Nov 20 low, Dec 22 high), then $191.6–193.6 (Dec 31 low and close) and $182.2. A close above $212.7 would target $220–223; below $201.9, $191.6–193.6.

r.en: Dec 8, 2025 high $205.00; Nov 5 low $211.63 and close $212.74, lost
